## Proposition / change

Describe the experiment, governance/control proposition, defect, or repository change addressed.

## Authority and scope

- Lab-owned surface affected:
- External regulatory/institutional/specification authority deliberately not changed:

## Evidence and validation

- [ ] applicable tests/validation pass;
- [ ] consequential negative/falsification cases are covered;
- [ ] missing, stale, or contradictory evidence is not represented as PASS;
- [ ] generated/publication surfaces remain aligned.

## Compatibility / assurance impact

Record experiment/evidence invalidation, schema/interface compatibility impact, or state `none`.

## Residual risk / visible judgment

Record material uncertainty, deferred work, and the judgment a future maintainer should recover from this PR.
